objective: Strategie de Mean-reversion sur SANDUSDC 1h. Indicateurs : ADX, RSI(14), ATR. Entree short quand ADX < 20 (range) et RSI > 70. Retournement en marche lateral. Stop-loss = 1.0x ATR, take-profit = 2.0x ATR.

iterations.hypothesis: Mean-reversion strategy on SANDUSDC exploits the tendency of price to return to its average after overbought conditions. ADX filters for range vs trending markets, ensuring entries only occur during consolidation. RSI identifies extreme overbought levels, while ATR provides dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels that scale with volatility.

The exit rule based on RSI crossing 50 is arbitrary and may exit too early.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, I'd switch to a breakout filter (price above/below 20-period SMA) combined with a 20-period RSI for entry. If mediocre Sharpe, I'd increase TP to 3x ATR and add a 10-period RSI filter to avoid entries in strong momentum. As alternative, I'd test a volatility-based momentum strategy using 50-period RSI with dynamic position sizing.

iterations.hypothesis: Using ADX as a range filter with RSI for mean-reversion signals improves entry timing by avoiding trades during strong trends, while ATR-based risk management ensures consistent risk-adjusted returns
